name: Entry Exit Align
definition: A sample placement strategy ensuring both the first and last samples are not under- or overestimated by taking the first sample half a step from the entry point and the last sample half a step from the exit point.
summary: Entry Exit Align is a volume raycasting strategy that minimizes boundary artifacts by aligning both the first and last samples with the ray's entry and exit points, unlike Entry Align which only aligns the first sample.
